item.title: Senate OKs bill to reduce number of crimes, ages of youth who can be charged as adults
item.description: The Maryland Senate, without debate, voted to trim the number of offenses that automatically land a juvenile in adult court. item.title: Maryland flag in the spotlight for more than its birthday celebration
item.description: ANNAPOLIS — Maryland will celebrate the 122nd birthday of its official state flag on Monday at a time when its symbols have become a political flashpoint. item.title: Study offers best picture yet of sinking land in the Chesapeake Bay region
item.description: Scientists have known for years that water levels are rising faster in the Chesapeake Bay region than just about anywhere else in the world — because water is only part of the problem here.
